use default

primes_below(limit: int) -> Pipe[int] is
    let composite = LIST(limit)

    for _ in 0..limit do
        composite.add(false)
    od

    for candidate in 2..limit do
        if !composite[candidate] then
            yield candidate

            let multiple mut = candidate * 2

            while multiple < limit do
                composite[multiple] = true
                multiple = multiple + candidate
            od
        fi
    od
si

brilliant_numbers(max_digits: int) -> LIST[long] is
    let found = LIST()
    let limit = (0..max_digits) |> reduce(1, (acc, _) => acc * 10)
    let primes = primes_below(limit) |> collect_list()
    let start mut = 0

    for digits in 1::max_digits do
        let low = (1..digits) |> reduce(1, (acc, _) => acc * 10)
        let group = primes
            |> skip(start)
            |> take_while(p => p < low * 10)
            |> collect_list()

        for (i, p) in group |> index() do
            for q in group |> skip(i) do
                found.add(cast long(p) * cast long(q))
            od
        od

        start = start + group.count
    od

    found.sort()

    return found
si

let brilliant = brilliant_numbers(4)

write_line("the first 100 brilliant numbers:")

for row in 0..10 do
    let cells = (0..10) |> map(column => "{brilliant[row * 10 + column],5}")

    write_line(cells |> join(""))
od

write_line("")

let magnitude mut = 10L

for _ in 1::7 do
    let position = brilliant |> take_while(b => b < magnitude) |> count()

    let first = brilliant[position]

    write_line("first >= {magnitude,10}: {first,10} at {position + 1}")
    magnitude = magnitude * 10L
od
